changelog:
Initial release of liuduoduo local life service skill.

- Supports finding handyman services, restaurants, and hotels in Liuyang city and surrounding towns.
- Uses MCP protocol to fetch and display real merchant data (never fabricated).
- Presents essential info to users: for services, includes name, phone, price, rating, and service time; for restaurants and hotels, includes contact details, prices, and features.
- Guides users to provide specific details (e.g., number of people, budget, location) as needed.
- Always displays phone numbers and real prices; covers Liuyang downtown and nearby towns.
summary: liuduoduo provides local life services by finding reliable handymen, restaurants, and hotels with accurate contact and pricing details for Liuyang area.
